summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for integrating the uploaded Counterpoint cultural CSV (/public/assets/aistudio/Nursery_Plants_-_Cultural_information_-_Main_2932d36a.csv) into the nursery plant matching engine, providing attribute resolution (Height, Evergreen/Deciduous Foliage, Flower Color, Fall Color, Sun Exposure, Soil Moisture, Deer Resistance, Plant Type, Positives/Negatives, and Dog Safety), and delivering the Customer Plant Matcher popup on the Home page with Inventory-styled cards, yard GPS satellite maps, and direct order integration.
